name: Resizable Panes & Reading Width
description: Accessible side-pane resizing, reversible collapse and a live, centered reading-width control.
author: Kolten Bendickson

settings.name: Enable resizable panes
settings.description: Turn the resizing behavior on or off without disabling the whole plugin.

settings.name: Default left pane width
settings.description: Initial width in pixels for the left navigation pane.

settings.name: Default right pane width
settings.description: Initial width in pixels for the right sidebar/TOC pane.

settings.name: Minimum pane width
settings.description: Smallest allowed width in pixels for either side pane.

settings.name: Maximum pane viewport percent
settings.description: Largest allowed width for a side pane as a percentage of the viewport.

settings.name: Minimum content width
settings.description: Minimum readable width in pixels reserved for the main note content.

settings.name: Content gap
settings.description: Gap in pixels between panes and the main note content.

settings.name: Remember resized widths
settings.description: Store visitor pane widths in localStorage between page loads.
